metadata.case_name: HO HOI YUEN v. TSANG HO LUN

plaintiff.occupation_before: Sole proprietor of Man Kee (trading and maintenance of sewing machine)

source: he was diagnosed as suffering from sprain neck.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of cervical spine, unspecified

injuries.description: protrusion of lumbar discs, narrowing of the sciatica and resultant lower back pain
source: The MRI showed protrusion of his lumbar discs, narrowing of the sciatica and resultant lower back pain.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

injuries.description: significant degenerative changes of the cervical and lumbar spine (pre-existing symptomatic lumbar spine degeneration)
source:
"[The plaintiff's] x-ray and MRI examination of the cervical 


 and lumbar spine showed significant degenerative changes which were NOT caused by the alleged traffic accident but must be pre-existing. He had pre-existing symptomatic lumbar spine degeneration."
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: injury to neck and shoulder due to the accident
source: I take the view that the plaintiff was injured to his neck and shoulder due to the accident and was only required to take 4 weeks sick leave.

manifestations.description: limited range of movement of neck and shoulder
limited range of movement of lower back
no neurological deficit on physical examination

treatments_received.treatment: transported by ambulance to hospital and discharged same day
source: he was taken by ambulance to the hospital and was discharged on the same day.
He received a total of 37 sessions of physiotherapy treatment.
he ... had received physiotherapy treatment and occupational therapy.

treatments_received.treatment: psychiatric treatment at Western Psychiatric Centre (from July 2010)
source: In July 2010, he started attending the Western Psychiatric Centre for treatment.

treatments_received.treatment: x-ray examination of waist and neck
source: He was referred to the Queen Mary Hospital for orthopaedic treatment and undergone x-ray examination of his waist and neck.
In 2010, he received MRI at Queen Mary Hospital.

treatments_received.treatment: analgesic medication (pain killers) in outpatient clinics
source: he ... was given pain killers ... after attending the said clinics.

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities resulting from neck and shoulder injury due to the accident

comparable_cases.case_name: Fan Jian Hui v Chan Hak Man
comparable_cases.injury_description: tenderness over neck and both lower legs, as well as head injury and has residual neck pain and the range of movement of his neck was reduced

comparable_cases.case_name: Li Ting Fai v Woo Chi Keung
comparable_cases.injury_description: neck injury in the form of paraspinal muscular tenderness with reasonable sick leave for 3 to 6 weeks, assessed as a mild case of whiplash neck injury affecting soft tissue only
